entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
Counsel for Applicant :- Anchit Srivastava,Abhay Dwivedi,Dharm Raj Mishra,Sanjai Srivast Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.

Hon'ble Rajeev Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State of U.P. and perused the record.

The present bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in Case Crime No.839 of 2020,
under Sections 420, 409, 506 I.P.C., Police Station Gomati Nagar, District Lucknow, with the prayer to enlarge him on bail.

Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has falsely been implicated in the present case as he was admin head in the company and the account was being operated by Rakesh Gupta and Abhinav Singh.
He further submitted that applicant is in jail since 10.07.2021 and charge sheet has already been filed and there is no possibility of conclusion of trial in near future.
Therefore, the applicant is also entitled for bail.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of bail of the applicant and submitted that during the course of investigation it is found that account of the company was operated by the applicant and huge amount was taken by the public, therefore, applicant is not entitled for bail.
Considering the arguments of learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and going through the contents of the F.I.R., other relevant documents, no case for bail is made out.
Accordingly, the bail application is hereby rejected.
Trial court is directed to conclude the trial expeditiously without giving any unnecessary adjournments of the parties.
The Commissioner of Police, Lucknow as well as the Joint Director of Prosecution, Lucknow are directed to ensure the presence of witnesses before the trial court.

Office is directed to communicate this order to the trial court as well as the Commissioner of Police,
Lucknow and the Joint Director of Prosecution, Lucknow for its necessary compliance forthwith.

Order Date :- 21.2.2023 Gaurav/-
